title: CrownThrive External MCP Certification Exit Plan

source_authority.caveat: The official conformance framework has a documented open issue in which the final 2026-07-28 release can still be treated as draft for tier arithmetic. Official-suite output is necessary evidence but not sufficient by itself; CrownThrive overlay tests remain mandatory.

required_sequence: bind the certification run to the exact canonical main SHA, signed payload digest, workflow SHA and active Edge deployment digest
activate only the pre-reviewed v4.1.0 GitHub OIDC certifier lane; its authority is MCP-only, D0-only, non-sovereign, protected-main/workflow/repository-bound and provider-dispatch-disabled by default
tighten the nine permissive central input schemas to documented allowlists
perform one bounded schema-capture pass across the 20 enabled central D0 tools: 12 CrownThrive IO reads plus 8 ThriveTools SEO reads
derive and independently review bounded per-operation output schemas and least-data projections from the sanitized captures plus provider contracts
preserve privacy-safe capture evidence as request-audit response hashes, capture-file SHA-256, derived bounded schemas and generated migration; do not print or publish provider response bodies
apply the reviewed bounded schemas/projections and rerun runtime output validation
run the CrownThrive external overlay negative/positive suite; only its final live-proof step may make one additional D0 read per dispatchable provider
run pinned @modelcontextprotocol/conformance@0.1.16 for MCP 2026-07-28 through provider-free certification mode and preserve complete conformance output in the governed workflow log
verify provider writes remain disabled and no non-D0 central tool is exposed
verify request audit records every bounded live provider read
independently review Security/Privacy and Operations/SRE evidence
move external_client_conformance_test to PASS only if every mandatory acceptance predicate is proven
keep Phase 3 blocked unless the separate Phase 2.99 hard exit and full-documentation gate also pass

provider_read_budget.derivation: 12 IO + 8 SEO schema-capture reads, then 1 IO + 1 SEO final live-proof reads; official conformance mode is provider-dispatch-disabled

mandatory_acceptance.claim: server/discover succeeds under protocol 2026-07-28 and returns tools capability plus private cache metadata
tools/list is deterministic, bounded to the governed central dispatch surface, and advertises valid JSON Schema 2020-12 input/output schemas
malformed MCP JSON returns JSON-RPC ParseError -32700 with null id
non-application/json MCP POST is rejected with HTTP 415 before body parsing
required MCP routing headers are checked against the JSON-RPC body and mismatch returns -32020
unsupported protocol version returns -32022 with the supported protocol list
unknown method returns in-band JSON-RPC -32601 using final 2026-07-28 transport semantics
all enabled central input schemas reject undeclared properties and preserve only documented bounded parameters
all enabled central output schemas are bounded operation-specific contracts and successful structuredContent validates against them
runtime endpoint catalog revocation is fail-closed at dispatch time
inbound and provider response bytes are bounded before full buffering and provider requests have explicit cancellation deadlines
provider success requires successful JSON parsing and least-data projection; malformed provider JSON cannot be surfaced as a successful tool result
at least one real D0 tool call per dispatchable provider succeeds through the external MCP client and creates durable request evidence
zero provider mutation tools and zero non-D0 central tools are exposed during certification

pinned official MCP conformance output, CrownThrive overlay output, privacy-safe schema-capture hashes and derived bounded-schema evidence are bound to the exact runtime/head/signed-payload evidence envelope

founder_signature.effect: Authorizes only the final certification implementation and bounded external live execution described in the exact signed payload. It does not authorize provider writes, non-D0 tool enablement, commercial acceptance, constitutional changes, or Phase 3 advancement.
